answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with an economic bond: every new identity must lock a pearl of value in a public registry, a stake no operator can harbor in secret. Mutual attestations weave a thread of trust that others audit before granting rights, so a forged account cannot borrow credit from honest agents. Since each fake identity needs its own locked bond, an attacker wanting a thousand votes must post a thousand stakes, and any thread caught colluding is slashed.
